function.name: hcaptcha_solve
function.description: Solve an hCaptcha challenge via the NoneCap gateway (pool of nc_live_ keys, auto-rotation, proxy fallback). Returns a P1_ token to inject into the target form's h-captcha-response field, together with the user_agent that MUST be used when submitting the token.

sitekey.description: hCaptcha sitekey of the target page

url.description: Full URL of the page hosting the hCaptcha

wait.description: Max seconds to block waiting for a terminal solve (1-90). Default 30.

stream.description: true = SSE stream of progress events (pick/solving/polling/result/error) instead of one JSON response

function.name: gateway_health
function.description: NoneCap gateway status: alive keys, proxy pool size, uptime, solved/failed counters.

function.name: gateway_pool
function.description: List pool keys with per-key balance/status (queried live through proxies).

function.name: fs_list
function.description: List a directory visible to the agent (whitelist: Desktop, tmp, SESSION-BASE). Returns names, dir flags, sizes.

path.description: Path relative to user home, e.g. 'Desktop/nonecap_accounts.txt' parent dir. Default: Desktop

function.name: fs_read
function.description: Read a text file visible to the agent (<=2MB, same whitelist as fs_list).

path.description: Path relative to user home, e.g. 'tmp/live_http_proxies.txt'

function.name: pool_reload
function.description: Re-read the key pool from nonecap_accounts.txt after new registrations.
